provider_trust_model.authentication: HMAC-SHA256 receipt authentication with a pinned external-key fingerprint
provider_trust_model.test_key_boundary: The repository regression secret is synthetic/public test material. It demonstrates authentication semantics only and MUST NOT be interpreted as a production trust root or credential.
provider_trust_model.production_requirement_remaining: A genuinely independent provider/registry/HSM/TPM/remote monotonic service identity and protected key material remain TEST_REQUIRED.

preconditions: existing anchor is readable and scope-bound
shift ledger passes complete internal integrity validation
ledger is exactly one accepted event ahead of anchor
provider-authenticated receipt binds exact previous anchor hash and exact observed anchor seq/head
provider-authenticated receipt binds exact current ledger seq/head, mission, step, installation, runtime, provider, key, domain and nonce
writer lock is held for the complete recovery transition
forbidden_recovery: automatic local recovery without an authenticated receipt
authenticated_crash_recovery.idempotency: Exact authenticated replay after recovery is a NO_OP; same recovery_id with different authenticated binding is IDENTITY_CONFLICT when the local recovery audit registry is intact.
authenticated_crash_recovery.crash_after_anchor_before_audit_registry: An authenticated receipt matching the already-advanced anchor may rebuild the local audit record without advancing the anchor again.

self_review_boundary.confirmed: Receipt HMAC authenticates exact recovery observations to the pinned synthetic provider identity and prevents arbitrary local auto-blessing.
self_review_boundary.not_claimed: Normal anchor states are not yet provider-attested on every append, and the local recovery audit registry is not itself independently rollback anchored. These remain distinct future trust-hardening targets.

formal_adoption: TEST_REQUIRED; NORMAL A_TO_B_TO_C ONLY AFTER EXACT EXECUTABLE EVIDENCE AND REMAINING VETO RESOLUTION
